[[File:Kendrick Summers DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Kendrick Summers, DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Kendrick Summers''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold Leader from Decipher Inc. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He later appeared as a regular SWCCG organized-play guest (Endor, DecipherCon).

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Summers is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>

== Anagrams ==
